roadAccident: 1. Ensure physical safety first: move to the side of the road if possible.
2. Call 108 (Ambulance) or 112 immediately if anyone is injured.
3. Take photos of the vehicle damage, road spot, and other vehicle's number plate.
4. Trigger the in-app SOS button on your platform (e.g. Swiggy/Zomato/Uber) to activate on-trip accidental insurance.
5. Do not sign any blank fault compromise papers on the spot before medical examination.
customerHarassment: 1. Remain polite but firm; do not engage in physical confrontation.
2. Activate in-app safety audio recording if supported, or step back to a public, well-lit area.
3. If threatened with violence, call 112 directly.
4. Mark the delivery/trip in the app with 'Safety Issue - Customer Aggression' before ending order so penalties are waived.
5. Note down the Customer Name, Order/Trip ID, and exact location.
heatwavePrecautions: 1. Drink water or ORS/lemon water every 45-60 minutes, even if not thirsty.
2. Wear light-coloured cotton clothes and cover your neck and face with a wet scarf/gamcha under your helmet.
3. Take 10-minute shaded breaks at platform rest stops, petrol pumps, or government 'Shramik Vishram Greh'.
4. Watch for heat exhaustion signs: dizziness, extreme headache, muscle cramps, vomiting. Stop riding immediately if feeling faint.
